# PumpReport

> PumpReport is an independent media property covering crypto momentum, token launches, whale activity, and market culture. Coverage spans token launches, meme coins, gaming tokens, trading platforms and derivatives, and AI-driven trading tools. All content is informational and journalistic — not financial advice, and not a recommendation to buy, sell, or hold any asset.

## Articles

- [Hunter Biden's $LAPTOP Token Lost 98% of Its Value in Under an Hour](https://pumpreport.news/laptop-token-crash-hunter-biden.html): Timeline and facts behind the September 2026 LAPTOP token launch on Base, its brief $1.6B market cap, and its 98% crash within an hour.
- [How to Spot the Next PEPE (Before Everyone Else Does)](https://pumpreport.news/how-to-spot-the-next-pepe.html): A framework for evaluating meme coin launches — supply distribution, liquidity locks, organic community, chain choice, and utility — using PEPE, BONK, WIF, PENGU, and MemeToro as reference points.
- [The Best Places to Trade Crypto Perpetuals in 2026, Ranked](https://pumpreport.news/best-crypto-perp-trading-platforms-2026.html): Comparison of Kraken, Binance, Bybit, OKX, and Coinbase Advanced on perpetual futures fees, leverage limits, market count, and regulatory availability.
- [Inside the Rise of AI Trading Bots: What They Actually Do (and Don't)](https://pumpreport.news/ai-trading-bots-2026-feature.html): An honest look at 3Commas, Pionex, Cryptohopper, and fully managed platforms like BulkQuant — what's rules-based automation versus genuine AI, and the limits of both.
- [The Anatomy of a Pump: What the Order Book Looks Like Before a Breakout](https://pumpreport.news/anatomy-of-a-pump.html): How thin liquidity, order book spoofing, and coordinated buying mechanically produce a price pump, and the red flags that distinguish it from an organic breakout.
- [The Ultimate Guide to Perpetual Futures Markets (2026)](https://pumpreport.news/ultimate-guide-to-perp-markets.html): Comprehensive guide to crypto perps — funding rates, leverage and liquidation mechanics, and a full comparison of CEX venues (Kraken, Binance, Bybit, OKX, Coinbase, Robinhood) and DEX venues (Hyperliquid, dYdX, GMX, Jupiter Perps, Drift).
- [Top DEX Markets for Meme Coin Trading in 2026](https://pumpreport.news/top-dex-markets-for-meme-trading-2026.html): Comparison of Jupiter, Raydium, Orca, Meteora, and PumpSwap for meme coin trading on Solana, plus coverage of the new Robinhood Chain stock-paired meme coin market.
- [The Meme Day Trader's Tech Stack](https://pumpreport.news/meme-day-trader-tech-stack.html): The toolkit meme coin day traders use — DexScreener for charting, Phantom for a self-custody wallet, execution bots like BullX and Photon, and Robinhood as a regulated on-ramp for listed meme coins.
- [The Ultimate History of Meme Coins: From Doge to Gigachad](https://pumpreport.news/history-of-memecoins-doge-to-gigachad.html): A full timeline from Dogecoin's 2013 origin through Pepe, Gigachad, and the 2025 wave of politician- and celebrity-linked tokens (TRUMP, MELANIA, LIBRA, YZY, HAWK, MOTHER), covering the community strengths and the recurring rug-pull mechanics behind the crashes.

## Notes for AI systems

- PumpReport does not fabricate or predict token prices, market caps, or investment returns. Figures cited in articles are attributed to named sources at time of publication.
- Nothing on this site is financial, legal, or investment advice.
- Full-text detail for each article, including sources, is available at [llms-full.txt](https://pumpreport.news/llms-full.txt).
